text:
**Not yet confirmed as persistent.** Hansen data indicate 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2025, or 3.91% of the asset. The JRC reference mapped 98% of the affected area as forest in 2020, supporting the pre-loss forest classification.

However, the series ends in 2025, so no later year has been observed to assess whether the loss persisted. The event therefore does not yet meet the tool’s corroboration rule, which requires both JRC agreement and a later-year observation.
